LanguageData.CoreSK_EnableBulkRecipeTip: Generate bulk variants for patched recipes. Requires a restart.
LanguageData.CoreSK_InfestationPreventionRadiusTip: After a deep drill triggers an infestation, all deep drills within this radius are temporarily prevented from triggering another one. Use this slider to adjust that radius.
LanguageData.CoreSK_NeverDieByLowHealthTip: Remove the health-based death check.\nRequires a restart after changing this setting.
LanguageData.CoreSK_AutoForbidSpoiled: Auto-forbid spoiled mush and meat outside the home area
LanguageData.CoreSK_AutoForbidSpoiledTip: Automatically forbid spoiled mush and meat generated outside the home area, so pawns do not cross the map to haul it into storage.
LanguageData.CoreSK_LogAllPatchOperationsTip: After this is enabled and the game is restarted, the setting should turn itself off automatically.
LanguageData.CoreSK_ErrorChecks: Debug only: check duplicate comps and other errors
